_comment: Shared by tests/test_serving_mirror.py (the Python mirror, scripts/forecast/serving_mirror.py) and tests/api/serving-mirror.test.ts (the app's TypeScript, lib/api/forecast.ts expandDay and lib/api/data.ts averageForecastDays). Both must produce `expected` exactly. Band colours/labels, computed_at and run_age_days are not mirrored and are left out of the comparison.

expand_cases.name: forecast with shape and band, tomorrow
exact half rounds UP like JavaScript (100.25 -> 100.3)
seasonal normal: no band, no shape for this city (flat hours)

expected.headline: Typical for this time of year — no recent reading to predict from

expand_cases.name: today's row, thin shape (missing hours default to 1)
pm25 row, data age counted to today not to the run

average_cases.name: seasonal_normal neighbour is left out when a real forecast exists
all seasonal_normal: averaged and labelled as such

value.headline: Typical for this time of year — no recent reading to predict from

average_cases.name: matched by DATE when stations have different days (audit 7.4)
one station without a shape: hours still averaged, not flat overall
